name: rail-organize-row-inset
description: rail: the organize-by control row (Rail.module.css's .organizeRow, between the Live section and the tier it controls) sits hard right with the SAME right inset the pinned-section heading actions use (.sectionHeadingAction): the switcher's IconButton right edge must line up with a section heading action's IconButton right edge, at the sidebar's min (200px) and default (280px) widths - it reads as chrome of the section below, not a floating control

mutation.declaration: Rail.module.css: .organizeRow's justify-content reverted from flex-end to flex-start (the control row renders left instead of hard right)
mutation.note: Both width fixtures fail with the switcher sitting the full row width minus the button left of the heading action's right edge; restoring justify-content: flex-end returns both to PASS.
